entities.name: Mangara's Harmony
entities.description: Century-long period of peace in northwestern Jamuraa orchestrated by Mangara of Corondor.

entities.name: Mangara of Corondor
entities.description: Wizard and diplomat who brokered peace in Jamuraa, later sealed in an Amber Prison.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Ambitious warlock who undermined the peace and began the Mirage War.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Mistress of beasts manipulated by Kaervek.

entities.name: Quirion Elves
entities.description: Elves who populated the neutral buffer zone and owed Mangara allegiance.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: Prison in which Mangara was sealed.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Ancient mage who reawakened when his isle returned.

events.summary: Mangara arrives in Jamuraa after meeting Jolrael and Kaervek and brokers peace among the nations, settling the Zhalfir-Femeref border with a buffer zone of Quirion Elves.
events.quote: Mangara brokered peace between the rival nations

events.summary: Kaervek resents the peace and persuades Jolrael that Mangara plans domination, sowing discord.
events.quote: he convinced her that Mangara's rule was but a prelude to domination

events.summary: Kaervek instigates skirmishes, then he and Jolrael ambush Mangara and seal him in an Amber Prison.
events.quote: Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed Mangara, sealing him within an Amber Prison

events.summary: With Mangara gone, the peace unravels and Kaervek's forces plunge the nations into the Mirage War.
events.quote: plunging the once-thriving nations into the Mirage War

events.summary: Teferi's Isle returns and Teferi reawakens.
events.quote: The ancient mage Teferi himself reawakened

relations.quote: In a brutal act of betrayal, Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed Mangara
Manipulating Jolrael’s distrust of human rulers
